decisions.reason: The exact-output ETH swap and ETH refund change does not alter the deferred Transak fiat-to-USDC mint flow or its supported payment methods.
The mint still costs 15 USD/USDC and the allocation among founder, affiliate, and prize pool is unchanged; only ETH conversion and excess-refund handling changes.
The decision applies only to ETH-to-USDC conversion and refund behavior, not direct USDC approval or mint execution.
ETH remains an available wallet-mint currency and the required end-to-end mint outcome is unchanged; the newly selected swap and refund semantics are already owned by the source Requirement.
Changing ETH swap input and refund handling does not change when mint-success feedback may be displayed.
The decision does not add or remove a payment method or change the requirement to disclose or select ETH and USDC.
The Transak fiat-buyer wallet creation, custody, holdings, and access paths are unaffected by the ETH exact-output swap.
The source decision does not change whether tipping is enabled, its interface location, or its preset and custom amounts.
The existing FAQ states the unchanged $15 mint price but contains no current claim about swapping all submitted ETH or refunding excess in USDC, so no copy is necessarily changed.
The About page's $15 purchase description and process content remain valid and do not specify the ETH swap or excess-refund mechanism.
The hero's $15 price, copy, emphasis, and layout remain unchanged by the internal ETH exact-output and refund behavior.
The collection remains an unlimited-mint NFT ebook; the ETH payment conversion mechanism does not change the collection model.
